_history: Step 5 (b6b8b3e): inline handlers replaced with delegation. All hashes MATCHED, which was the point: a pure refactor must not change rendered output.

Sample event + pick lists + keypads: RE-BASELINED. Four hashes moved on purpose. tab_config gained the car/track datalists and the Load Sample Event button; tab_fuel, modals and tab_schedule gained inputmode attributes (tab_schedule by exactly 20 chars, one inputmode=numeric). tab_ops, tab_avail, tab_goals, strip and the stint digest were untouched and must stay untouched.

Pickers rebuilt as <select>: RE-BASELINED, tab_config only. datalist gives iOS Safari no dropdown at all, so Car Class / Car / Track became real selects with an Other escape hatch, and the car list now narrows to the chosen class. Everything else unchanged, which is the expected shape of a change confined to one card on one tab.

Build stamp moved: RE-BASELINED, tab_config only. The stamp was briefly a large floating overlay, which was the wrong call for something checked a few times a year. It now sits at the foot of the Config tab and the corner mark went back to quiet decoration.
Live Sync card added: RE-BASELINED, tab_config only. The app is now wired to the Cloudflare backend; the old Google Sheet card is retained below it, labelled as retiring.

Multi-car entries + readability: RE-BASELINED. tab_config shrank (retired Google Sheet card deleted), strip grew (event name became the entry switcher), modals 7 to 8 (car list added). tab_ops, tab_schedule, tab_avail, tab_goals and the stint digest are UNCHANGED, which is the proof that adding entries did not disturb the single-entry rendering path.

Phone layout pass: RE-BASELINED. modals grew (Position and Repair Time added to the stint note popup, because the phone table hides those columns). tab_config hash moved at IDENTICAL length, which is just the build stamp string. Everything else unchanged: the column hiding and the config overflow fix are CSS only and change no markup.

Redesign, phase 1: RE-BASELINED. tab_schedule grew by 70 chars (data-l labels on five cells so the phone card layout can render column names); tab_config moved by the build stamp plus the reworked prerequisites button. Everything else unchanged: the card layout, type scale and colour changes are CSS only.
